checkpoint.purpose: SKU condition alignment v3: same four table steps and the same similarity matrices as v2 (copied), with matched_by (identical or model) recorded on every aligned or extra condition and in the score. Value pairs, axis split, decisions, diff against rule gate v10, the Codex handoff, the score for the 29 pairs and the manual axis reference.
checkpoint.extract_at: repository root; preserve .lab-output relative paths; use unzip -n
checkpoint.label_derived_content: legacy/align/score.json holds aggregate counts against the Luna v3 machine labels of the 29 confirmed pairs and Claude's manual axis reference (not blind). No raw labels; family has no labels.
